hints.title: Parity State Tracking
hints.text: Maintain running maximum sums where the current element is added or subtracted.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: At index i, an added term can either start a new subarray or extend a preceding subtracted term.

hints.title: Global Maximum
hints.text: Update the best answer considering all valid single or multi-element alternating subarrays.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumAlternatingSubarraySum(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        ans = nums[0]
        pos = nums[0]
        neg = float('-inf')

        for x in nums[1:]:
            new_pos = max(x, neg + x)
            new_neg = pos - x
            pos, neg = new_pos, new_neg
            ans = max(ans, pos, neg)
        return ans
```

complexity.time: O(N) single pass through numbers array
complexity.notes: Tracks optimal alternating sums ending with positive and negative parity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force checking all O(N^2) subarrays takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Kadane-like alternating state variables yield optimal linear time and constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should identify the two interleaved state transitions.
